news.title: Taapsee Pannu Serves Striking Retro Elegance in New Shoot
news.summary: Actor Taapsee Pannu has showcased a bold retro fashion look in a recent photoshoot featuring vintage-styled backdrops and a black-and-gold floral outfit. Despite facing box office setbacks with her 2026 releases Advocate Raavi and Gandhari, she continues working on projects like Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?. Throughout her career, she has remained resilient against early industry hurdles by choosing roles that truly fulfill her.

news.title: Sambarala Yeti Gattu Keeps Its Original Sankranti Release Slot
news.summary: The makers of Sai Durga Tej's mass action film Sambarala Yeti Gattu have confirmed that their theatrical schedule remains unchanged despite overlapping announcements. Directed by Rohith KP and produced by Chaitanya Reddy, the movie is in its final post-production stage. It is slated to hit screens on January 12, 2027, maintaining its position in the upcoming festive race alongside other major releases.

news.title: Hombale Films Acquires Southern Regional Rights for Hanuman Ansh
news.summary: Following a strong commercial performance in the Hindi belt, the low-budget feature Hanuman Ansh is expanding its reach into southern markets. Prominent production banner Hombale Films has secured the regional dubbing rights for the multi-part project. Directed by Vishal Chaturvedi, the narrative chronicles the spiritual journey of Lakshmi Narayan and his transformation into Neem Karoli Baba.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Action Sequences for Dragon in October
news.summary: Following a temporary break due to a shoulder injury, actor NTR is scheduled to return to the sets of his upcoming project Dragon. Director Prashanth Neel has continued filming other sequences in the interim, while a major stunt schedule is planned in Mumbai starting October 10. Co-starring Rukmini Vasanth, Anil Kapoor, and Biju Menon, the high-profile venture is backed by Mythri Movie Makers and NTR Arts.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi's Next Starrer Nears Final Completion Phase
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is wrapping up the final portions of his upcoming film starring Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty. The production team is planning an Ooty schedule in early October followed by overseas song shoots to wrap filming by mid-November. With GV Prakash Kumar handling the background score and dubbing underway, the movie is on track for a January 12 theatrical release.

news.title: Theatrical Trailer of Chakkora Unveiled in Hyderabad
news.summary: The trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird, directed by debutant Manga Srinivas, has been launched in Hyderabad by Aakash Jagannadh. The film stars Sravan as a carefree young man whose life upends after falling for Julie, played by Malaika T. Vasupal, before she mysteriously disappears. Backed by High Joy Commercials and VIP, the musical romance is scheduled for a worldwide release on October 9.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of Nitesh Tiwari's multi-part Ramayana have released new promotional stills showcasing Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as Ram, Sita, and Lakshman. A separate first look was also revealed for Yash as Ravana, highlighting his regal appearance and golden crown as the king of Lanka. Backed by Prime Focus Studios and other production houses, Part 1 is slated for a Diwali 2026 release.

news.title: Manga Srinivas Directorial Chakkora Drops Official Trailer
news.summary: The theatrical trailer for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird introduces a blend of lighthearted romance and a sudden mystery following the disappearance of the female lead, Julie. Directed by Manga Srinivas and starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the film features music by Prince Henry. It is set to hit theaters globally on October 9 via Sri Lakshmi Pictures.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Impressive Box Office Momentum
news.summary: Despite facing mixed reactions from critics upon its initial release, Nani's latest film The Paradise has continued to pull in strong box office collections. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the big-budget project experienced a notable rise in revenue across Telugu states and is performing well in international markets like the UK, Australia, and the US.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Mumbai Shoot for Dragon After Injury Recovery
news.summary: Actor NTR is gearing up to return to film sets following a period of recuperation from a shoulder surgery that kept him sidelined for nearly two months. He will join the upcoming schedule of his pan-India film Dragon in Mumbai starting October 10 for a 15-day stint featuring high-octane action scenes alongside Anil Kapoor.

news.title: The Paradise Faces Critical Box Office Evaluation on Monday
news.summary: Following a strong opening weekend that brought in massive box office numbers, Nani's ambitious action drama The Paradise is now bracing for its crucial weekday test. While initial earnings have been substantial, trade analysts note that the film needs consistent momentum in the coming days to meet its ambitious target and recover investments across territories.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters of Ranbir Kapoor and Yash Unveiled for Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the much-anticipated mythological epic Ramayana have released striking new character visuals highlighting Yash as a regal Ravana alongside a serene depiction of the trio of Ram, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the pan-India project is slated for a grand two-part release during the Diwali festivals of 2026 and 2027.

news.title: Nagarjuna's Milestone Project King100 Planned with a Special Character Reveal for Tabu
news.summary: The makers of Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone film King100 are preparing to release a special teaser introducing Tabu's character. Tabu, who shares a memorable onscreen history with Nagarjuna from past hits like Ninne Pelladutha, stars as one of the female leads in this Ra Karthik directorial.

news.title: Makers of Vijay Deverakonda Starrer Ranabaali Launch Four-Part Promotional Docu-Series
news.summary: To build anticipation for Rahul Sankrityan's historical drama Ranabaali, the production team is launching a four-part documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The series highlights two years of historical research on Rayalaseema and features discussions with lead actor Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, and the director.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Exhibits Steady Box Office Holding on Day Three in Nizam
news.summary: The Srikanth Odela directorial The Paradise maintained a steady box office performance in the Nizam region on its third day. The action drama brought in close to Rs. 5 crore in share, pushing its total share to approximately Rs. 23 crore as it heads into the crucial Sunday collections.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Applauds Nani and Srikanth Odela's The Paradise After Hyderabad Screening
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR attended a screening of Nani's latest movie The Paradise at Sudarshan Theatre in Hyderabad. He praised the cast and crew for vividly portraying Telangana's cultural identity and depicting the struggles of an oppressed community on screen.

news.title: OTT Valuations Favor Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Industry circles indicate that streaming platforms offer higher financial valuations for female-centric projects led by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Rashmika's involvement in major pan-Indian hits and her expansive social media following heavily influence these digital rights pricing trends.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales on Day Three
news.summary: Despite facing mixed and largely critical initial reviews, the Nani-led film The Paradise continues to perform solidly at the box office. On its third day, the movie sold 252,000 tickets on BookMyShow, matching its robust second-day momentum and pushing past ₹115 crore gross in just two days.

news.title: Wildcard Entrant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu 10 With Cash Prize
news.summary: In a surprising turn of events on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, recent wildcard contestant Mithilesh accepted a ₹15 lakh cash offer from the makers and walked out of the house. Having entered just a day prior, Mithilesh defended his abrupt departure by stating that the house dynamics made a winning path impossible.

news.title: Nani Confident About The Paradise Box Office Run During Hyderabad Media Meet
news.summary: During a press meet in Hyderabad for The Paradise, actor Nani expressed immense confidence in the film's long-term box office prospects, calling it a long-distance runner. He praised the relentless hard work of the entire crew, the musical contribution of Anirudh, and the visionary direction of Srikanth Odela.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls The Paradise Role The Most Ferocious Of His Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu recently praised director Srikanth Odela and lead star Nani during a press meet for their newly released film, The Paradise. The seasoned performer revealed that he took the most retakes of his career for this project and praised the director's exceptional vision. He also lauded Nani's hard work and dedication in pulling off his demanding character.

news.title: Nani Highlights Unique Box Office Trend For The Paradise
news.summary: Natural Star Nani shared his astonishment over the unusual audience reception for his latest theatrical release, The Paradise, directed by Srikanth Odela. Unlike standard box office trajectories, the film experienced a unique shift where initial reactions grew progressively more positive with successive screenings. The high-budget project is backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri and features an ensemble cast.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Unveiled For The Mythological Epic Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming big-budget mythological spectacle Ramayana have unveiled striking new character posters featuring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Yash. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, the film utilizes cutting-edge visual effects by DNEG. The grand cinematic venture is scheduled for a worldwide IMAX release during Diwali 2026.

news.title: Pen Studios Secures All-India Theatrical Rights For Love And War
news.summary: Following a massive deal for Shah Rukh Khan's King, Pen Studios has acquired the domestic theatrical distribution rights for Sanjay Leela Bhansali's upcoming directorial Love And War. The high-profile drama stars Ranbir Kapoor, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal in the lead roles. Backed by a commission-based agreement, the movie is slated to hit theaters during the Republic Day week in January 2027.
